chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) and a group of my scholars narrated to me from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Sandal, from Harun ibn Harizah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

When it is the middle of Sha'ban, a caller calls out from the highest horizon: O those who have come to the Ziyarah of Husayn (peace be upon him)! Return, forgiven; your reward is with your Lord and Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), your Prophet.

key_terms.النِّصْفُ مِنْ شَعْبَانَ: The fifteenth of the month of Sha'ban
key_terms.زَائِرِي الْحُسَيْنِ: Those who perform Ziyarah of Husayn

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the fifteenth of Sha'ban for those who perform Ziyarah of Imam Husayn?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this hadith from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat* highlights the spiritual elevation of the 15th of Sha'ban (Laylat al-Bara'at) as a time when the merits of visiting Imam Husayn are magnified. The 'caller from the highest horizon' signifies a divine proclamation of acceptance, linking the pilgrim’s devotion directly to the Prophet and securing their reward with Allah. This underscores the intercessory role of the Ahl al-Bayt and the tangible spiritual benefits of Ziyarah in Shia piety.
